roster_grade.headline: 4-0 and legit — elite QB/WR spine carrying a top record; RB is the one spot to upgrade for a title push
roster_grade.window_explanation: Off to a 4-0 start (309 PF). Mahomes + a deep WR corps + Loveland at TE are winning games now. The window is wide open — this is a buy season, not a sell one.

strengths.label: Winning now (4-0)
strengths.detail: 309 points for, top of the standings. The roster is producing, not just theoretically good.

strengths.label: QB strength
strengths.detail: Mahomes (6,188) is your rock; Bo Nix (4,257) and Shough (4,026) give you a genuine surplus in a 2-QB league — real trade ammunition.

strengths.label: Deep, productive WR
strengths.detail: Smith, Parker Washington, Watson, Higgins all starting and producing; 12 WRs total means clear surplus to deal from.

strengths.label: Loveland + pick capital
strengths.detail: Elite young TE1, plus a 2028 1st from Bijan Mustard (now 0-4 — likely a premium pick) and a 2027 2nd from Pitts.

weaknesses.label: RB is aging and thin
weaknesses.detail: Henry (32), Javonte (26 declining), Hubbard (27 declining) are your starters. Harvey (25) and rookies Claiborne/Randall are the only youth. This is the spot to upgrade while you're winning.

weaknesses.label: Value vs record gap
weaknesses.detail: You're 4-0 but mid-pack by roster value — you're outperforming your talent. Use the hot start to buy a difference-maker before regression.

weaknesses.label: Thin behind Loveland at TE
weaknesses.detail: Hockenson and Helm are depth only; one starter is all you need, so this is fine.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: You're 4-0 — buy, don't sell. Convert your QB surplus (Shough, or Bo Nix for the big swing) plus a declining RB into a real running back. Bijan Mustard (0-4, weak at QB) and Lemon Party (0-4, weak QB+RB, holds Jeremiyah Love) are the motivated sellers to target.

QB.commentary: Mahomes elite; Bo Nix + Shough are surplus starters — your trade currency.

RB.commentary: Producing but old: Henry/Javonte/Hubbard all declining. Harvey + rookies are the future. Upgrade target #1.

WR.commentary: Deep and starting well; clear surplus to package. Threat Level Midnight (weak WR, win-now) is a live market.

TE.commentary: Loveland is elite; steep drop after, but you only start one.

trade_priority_order: BUY a young RB while you're 4-0 — Breece Hall (efficient) or Bijan (all-in) from Bijan Mustard; Jeremiyah Love from Lemon Party
Sell Tyler Shough (QB3) to a QB-needy 0-4 team (Bijan Mustard, Lemon Party) as the centerpiece

Move Javonte to an RB-needy team (Quarterback Factory, Un-Kirk Penix)

Bo Nix — keep unless the return is Bijan-tier (then he's the price)
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: You're winning — picks are currency, not treasures. Package the 2027 2nd and 2nd-4th rounders to buy RB help now. Hold the 2028 1st from Bijan Mustard (0-4 = likely premium) unless it headlines a Bijan-tier deal.

pick_strategy.portfolio_summary: Draft complete (slot 9): Sadiq (since traded to Bijan Mustard for a 2028 1st), Stribling, Claiborne, Randall. Hold a 2028 1st (from Bijan Mustard) and a 2027 2nd (from Pitts).

outlook.projected_power_rank: 1st-tier by record (4-0, 309 PF) — outperforming a mid-pack roster value. A real contender riding a hot start.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Window is open now on the QB/WR/TE spine. Sustaining it means converting the hot start into a younger RB core before Henry/Javonte fall off.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 4-0 and leading the pack. Mahomes and a deep WR room are winning games; Loveland is an elite TE1. The one soft spot — an aging RB room — is exactly what a 4-0 team should spend surplus to fix. Three teams are 0-4 and selling (Bijan Mustard, Un-Kirk Penix, Lemon Party); that's your buyers' market. Strike now while your record gives you leverage and your QB/WR surplus has peak value.
key_risks: Regression — 4-0 on mid-pack value won't hold without an upgrade
Sitting on QB/WR surplus while its value decays
key_upside_factors: Landing Hall or Bijan turns RB from a weakness into a strength
A young WR (Stribling off IR, Bech, Cyrus Allen) breaks out

teams_to_watch.why: 0-4, weak at QB, holds Bijan + Hall + Odunze — your prime RB seller. Shough/Nix are the keys.
